'''Che'nash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Geranite/Legends|Geranite]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] operative working as part of the [[Shrikaansi Reconnaissance Company]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] at the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Che'nash was a part of a mercenary team, hired by the Sith Empire and deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] at the end of the Cold War. Her team was tasked with uncovering information on a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] operation code named "[[Battle of Ilum|Shatterstorm]]," which involved the Republic's [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] commandos. However, they were unable to complete their mission alone, and were forced to seek the help of other Imperial operatives.<ref name="TOR1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Che'nash first appeared in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR1" />

She is only accessible to Imperial players in the game on Ilum.<ref name="TOR1" />
